score_rationale: Priya Nair has a strong technical foundation and some leadership experience, but significant gaps remain in direct experience with Node.js and .NET, as well as in evidence of managing teams through major technical changes.
key_strengths: Solid technical background in modern web stacks (React/TypeScript, AWS), some leadership experience in mentoring and project delivery.
key_weaknesses: Lacks direct experience with Node.js and .NET, minimal evidence of managing teams through technical change.
final_evaluation: Priya Nair is technically competent and has leadership potential, but the lack of specific Node.js/.NET experience and clear evidence of leading teams through major technical transformations makes her a less ideal fit for this specialized role.
